accretion.F90: Rain-cloud accretion (racw) and related warm-rain accretion process rates.
activation.F90: Cloud droplet activation from aerosol via a fixed-CCN/simple activation scheme.
adjust_deposition.F90: Rescales ice/snow/graupel vapour deposition rates to stay physically consistent with the available vapour.
aerosol_routines.F90: Aerosol mode partitioning and CCN/dust activation (Abdul-Razzak & Ghan 2000), used when aerosol_option>0.
aggregation.F90: Rain self-collection (racr) and snow self-aggregation (ice_aggregation) process rates.
casim_moments_mod.F90: Computes an output moment of the hydrometeor size distribution from an input moment (UM lsp_moments equivalent).
casim_parent.F90: Defines identifiers for which parent model (KiD/MONC/UM) is driving CASIM.
casim_reflec_mod.F90: Computes radar reflectivity (dBZ) from the hydrometeor size distributions.
casim_runtime.F90: Module-level runtime state shared across CASIM: current column/level indices and elapsed simulation time.
casim_stph.F90: Stochastic-physics (random parameter) settings for CASIM, updated by the parent model and applied to fall-speed/cloud-number parameters.
cloud_fraction_dummy.F90: Dummy cloud-fraction scheme (module cloud_frac_scheme) used so MONC and KiD builds link.
condensation.F90: Condensation/evaporation of cloud water and droplet activation (condevp).
derived_constants.F90: Derives cross-species size-distribution constants (set_constants) needed for consistent phase conversions.
distributions.F90: Derives size-distribution parameters (n0, lambda, mu) for each hydrometeor from its moments (query_distributions).
dust_hack.F90: Hard-coded placeholder dust/soluble-aerosol number/mass concentrations used as a stand-in aerosol field.
evaporation.F90: Rain evaporation and CCN re-activation bookkeeping (revp).
gauss_4A_func.F90: Numerical double-integral (gauss_casim_func) used in the snow self-aggregation collision kernel.
generic_diagnostic_variables.F90: Declares the casdiags diagnostic flags/arrays shared with the parent model.
homogeneous_freezing.F90: Homogeneous freezing of rain and cloud droplets below -40C (ihom_rain, ihom_droplets).
ice_accretion.F90: Binary accretion process rates between hydrometeor species (iacc), e.g. snow/graupel accreting cloud or rain.
ice_deposition.F90: Vapour deposition growth of ice, snow and graupel (idep).
ice_melting.F90: Melting of ice, snow and graupel (melting).
ice_multiplication.F90: Secondary ice production: Hallet-Mossop rime splintering, droplet shattering, and ice-ice collisional fragmentation.
ice_nucleation.F90: Heterogeneous ice nucleation (inuc), five selectable schemes.
initialize.F90: Top-level CASIM initialisation/finalisation (mphys_init, mphys_finalise): validates options, sets constants and lookup tables.
lognormal_funcs.F90: Inverts lognormal aerosol-mode mass/number to a mean radius (MNtoRm).
lookup.F90: Gamma-function lookup helpers and size-distribution-parameter inversion (Gfunc, moment, get_n0, get_mu, get_slope_generic family).
m3_incs.F90: Algebraic third-moment increments on phase change/process rates (m3_inc_type1-4).
micro_main.F90: Main CASIM entry point (shipway_microphysics): orchestrates per-column microphysics over a full 3D grid.
mphys_constants.F90: Physical constants used throughout CASIM (e.g. density of water, reference density).
mphys_die.F90: Error/warning reporting and termination for CASIM (throw_mphys_error, mphys_message).
mphys_parameters.F90: Defines the hydro_params derived type and per-species (cloud/rain/ice/snow/graupel) size-distribution parameters.
mphys_switches.F90: Runtime switches/options controlling which CASIM process schemes and moments are active.
mphys_tidy.F90: Enforces positivity/consistency of hydrometeor and aerosol moments after each process update.
passive_fields.F90: Column fields that are read but not updated during a microphysics timestep (rho, pressure, z, exner, w, tke, ...).
precision.F90: Determines default real precision (defp) from the host compiler.
preconditioning.F90: Flags which columns/levels have any microphysics work to do, to skip empty ones (preconditioner).
process_routines.F90: Process-rate bookkeeping: allocation/deallocation/zeroing of the procs and aerosol_procs arrays.
qsat_casim_func.F90: Saturation mixing ratio (Tetens formula) over liquid/ice and its temperature derivative.
sedimentation.F90: Sedimentation of hydrometeors (Eulerian flux-form, sedr/sedr_1M_2M) and CFL substep selection.
ship_tracks.F90: Ship-track aerosol emission source locations/settings (module ship_tracks_casim).
special.F90: Special mathematical functions: Gamma function (lookup table), error function/complementary error function, and their inverses.
sum_procs.F90: Accumulates hydrometeor and aerosol process rates into tendencies, including latent heating (sum_procs, sum_aprocs).
sweepout_rate.F90: Single- and two-species hydrometeor collection/sweep-out rate kernels used by the accretion/aggregation routines.
thresholds.F90: Small/tidy/significant/large threshold values used to decide when microphysics processes are active.
type_aerosol.F90: Declares the aerosol_type derived type describing an aerosol mode distribution.
type_process.F90: Declares the process_rate and process_name derived types used for process-rate bookkeeping.
variable_precision.F90: Defines the working real/integer kind parameters (wp, iwp, ...) used throughout CASIM.
ventfac.F90: Ventilation factor calculation for depositional/evaporative growth (ventilation_3M, ventilation_1M_2M).
which_mode_to_use.F90: Partitions evaporated aerosol mass/number between CCN modes (which_mode).
shipway_activation/shipway_activation_mo: Shipway (2015) revised droplet activation scheme (peak supersaturation approximation).
shipway_activation/shipway_constants.F90: Physical constants used by the Shipway activation scheme.
shipway_activation/shipway_erf.F90: Error function/complementary error function used by the Shipway activation scheme.
shipway_activation/shipway_lookup.F90: Lookup-table parameters/grid used by the Shipway activation scheme.
shipway_activation/shipway_parameters.F9: Aerosol-mode parameters (number, radius, solubility) used by the Shipway activation scheme.
